record.context_brief: Homogeneous non-cutoff Boltzmann, very soft potentials
record.original_question: For the space-homogeneous non-cutoff Boltzmann equation in the regime gamma + 2s < 0, do global-in-time classical solutions exist? The paper identifies this very soft potential regime as unresolved even though homogeneous well posedness is understood when gamma + 2s >= 0.

evidence.quote: From a mathematical perspective, the homogeneous problem is significantly simpler than the inhomogeneous. The well posedness is well understood in the homogeneous non-cutoff Boltzmann equation when γ + 2s ≥ 0. Remarkably, the existence of global in time classical solutions when γ + 2s < 0 remains open.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the spatially homogeneous non-cutoff Boltzmann equation
\[ \partial_t f(t,v) = Q(f,f)(t,v), \qquad t>0,\ v\in\mathbb{R}^3, \]
with initial data f(0,v)=f_0(v)\ge 0, where the collision operator is
\[ Q(f,f)(v)=\int_{\mathbb{R}^3}\int_{S^2} B(|v-v_*|,\cos\theta)\bigl(f(v')f(v_*')-f(v)f(v_*)\bigr)\,d\sigma\,dv_*, \]
with the standard pre/post-collisional velocities
\( v'=\tfrac{v+v_*}{2}+\tfrac{|v-v_*|}{2}\sigma,\ v_*'=\tfrac{v+v_*}{2}-\tfrac{|v-v_*|}{2}\sigma \),
and a collision kernel of the form
\[ B(|v-v_*|,\cos\theta) = |v-v_*|^{\gamma}\,b(\cos\theta), \]
where the angular part has the non-integrable singularity
\[ b(\cos\theta)\sin\theta \sim \theta^{-1-2s} \quad\text{as } \theta\to 0^+, \]
for some s\in(0,1) and \gamma\in(-3,1). Assume the initial datum f_0 has finite mass, energy, and entropy.

Problem. In the very soft potential regime \gamma+2s<0, do there exist global-in-time classical (smooth) solutions to the above Cauchy problem for general such initial data, without conditional smallness or a priori bounds?
artifact.status_search_result: Recent works (2024–2025) on the homogeneous non-cutoff Boltzmann with very soft potentials provide only conditional results (e.g., conditional integrability/stability assuming suitable a priori L^p bounds, or local well-posedness), confirming that unconditional global existence of classical solutions in the regime γ+2s<0 remains open. Global classical solutions are established for γ+2s≥0, while for γ+2s<0 only measure/weak or conditional solutions are known.

status_evidence.title: Conditional integrability and stability for the homogeneous Boltzmann equation with very soft potentials
status_evidence.snippet: Conditional integrability and stability results for the homogeneous Boltzmann equation with very soft potentials.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work provides only conditional results in the very soft regime, indicating unconditional global classical solutions remain open.

status_evidence.title: Local Well-Posedness for the Boltzmann Equation with Very Soft Potential
status_evidence.snippet: Local well-posedness for very soft potential with polynomially decaying initial data.
status_evidence.claim: Only local (not global) well-posedness is established for very soft potentials.

status_evidence.title: Regularity estimates for the non-cutoff soft potential Boltzmann equation
status_evidence.snippet: Regularity estimates with rough slowly decaying data for the non-cutoff soft potential Boltzmann equation.
status_evidence.claim: Active research continues on regularity in soft-potential regimes, without resolving global existence of classical solutions when γ+2s<0.
